name: The Boomer
description: An extremely bloated and fragile Special Infected that produces massive quantities of bile. The Boomer moves slowly but can vomit bile to blind survivors and summon a small horde, sowing general confusion. Upon death, they explode and shower nearby players with bile. While powerless alone due to extremely low health and range, their presence forces survivors to spread out, creating perfect openings for other Special Infected to strike
